**Daily Briefing - June 3rd, 2026**

Yesterday's 11.5km run shows solid aerobic work at 153bpm average — right where we want you in this build phase. Your 5.4 hours of sleep is concerning though, Karl. That's well below the 7-8 hours your body needs for proper adaptation, especially after a 66-minute effort that burned significant energy from your 3,158 total calories.

Your HRV at 110ms sits perfectly within baseline range and that 45bpm resting heart rate signals good recovery. However, your TSB of -20 screams high fatigue, and your training load data backs this up. Your body is absorbing the work but teetering on the edge of productive stress versus overreach.

Today demands smart decision-making. Given the fatigue signals and sleep debt, I'm recommending you either skip today's planned session or convert it to an easy 20-minute recovery jog at conversational pace. Your stress level of 21 is manageable, but we must respect what the numbers are telling us about accumulated load.

Remember, fitness builds during recovery, not just during the work itself. Protecting today means being stronger tomorrow. We're only week 3 of 20 — plenty of time to build the engine that will carry you under 4 hours in Chester. Trust the process and listen to your body's wisdom.
